name: Eventbrite Vienna
notes: no price in listing (needs a per-event detail fetch we skip), so price_min/price_text are always null; site rate-limits aggressively (429) after ~45+ requests in a short window across runs, so avoid re-running check.py back-to-back; also fetches https://www.eventbrite.at/d/austria--wien/board-games/ (capped at 6 pages) to plug the gaming/board-games blind spot -- it's a full-text search (q="board games"), not a real category filter, so most hits are noise, but it reliably surfaces a handful of genuine finds (chess meetups, board-game conventions) the all-events ranking never returns; merged with all-events and deduped on the shared source_id key; tried gaming/tabletop-gaming/video-games/hobbies too and they search the same ~1017-item fuzzy pool with no better gaming signal, so left out to conserve request budget
